description: What a role and level earns in a US metro: median base salary from public US government data (H-1B filings and the BLS wage survey), with the middle half, the source and its date, and how a given base compares. Base pay only, equity and bonus excluded; an estimate, not a verdict, and it does not change compute_walk_away_verdict. Use it when the person asks whether their pay is at market, before or after the verdict.

base.description: Current annual base salary in dollars; with it the result says how it compares to the median

level.description: Level id: junior (Junior), mid (Mid), senior (Senior), staff (Staff), principal (Principal or above)

metro.description: Metro id such as "us-sfo", "us-sea", "us-nyc"; "remote-us" has no data

role.description: Role id: swe (Software engineer), ml (ML or AI engineer), research (Research scientist), postdoc (Postdoc / academic to industry), data_sci (Data scientist), data_eng (Data engineer), sre (SRE or infrastructure), em (Engineering manager), pm (Product manager), designer (Product designer), other (Other)

name: check_market_base_pay
title: Market base pay check
